fusions.name: Fire in the Hole
fusions.desc: Lobs a blasting charge that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets and 80% of that to every enemy within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Loaded with Grit
fusions.desc: Fires 4 loads of grit at once, spread apart, each dealing 5 damage and throwing its target back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Rifle Pit
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to dig a pit beside you and set a loaded piece in it for 12 seconds. Every 1.2 seconds it fires on an enemy within 6 tiles and deals 5 damage.

fusions.name: Parapet Rest
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 8% and your armour by 6%.
